rationale: The funding-gap level (capx − oancf, i.e. negative free cash flow to assets) is a substantively different construction from the archive's capex-growth/acceleration variants and the industry ranking is a sensible control, though the base leg is close to the known low-free-cash-flow / cash-based-profitability anomaly, so incremental content over that is the main open question.

Using the goodwill stock rather than acquisition flow is a genuinely different mechanism from the archive's aqc-based signals and the leverage-plus-loss overlay is coherent, but RANK(COALESCE(gdwl,0)) piles a large no-goodwill mass at the bottom rank, which will mechanically flatten the interaction and should be checked in coverage/portfolio-composition diagnostics.

This is essentially a recombination of components already tested in the archive (capex level from Cash-Burning Capex Commitment, −oancf/at from Cash-Flow-Strained Capex Acceleration, Δdebt/at from Debt-Financed Loss Acquisition), so it is a cosmetic variant that also overlays two well-known anomalies (asset growth/investment and net debt issuance) without a new economic distinction.

Shifting from inventory growth (Thomas–Zhang territory, already tested here) to inventory share of current assets is a legitimately different construct, but note that invt/act and che/at are mechanically complementary components of current assets, so part of the product just squares the same liquidity-composition variable and the marginal role of the −che leg should be tested separately.

Deliberately testing the underinvestment side (low capex plus old net-to-gross PPE) against the standard investment anomaly is an economically interesting, non-obvious hypothesis with a correctly signed expression, though the main risk is that the product collapses into a generic financial-distress proxy, so a distress-controlled version should be part of the follow-up.

Since wcap = act − lct, the −wcap/at leg carries essentially the same information as the lct/act leg in the already-tested Distress Hiring Mismatch (fmb_tstat = +1.12, wrong sign), making this a cosmetic proxy swap on a construction that has already failed cross-sectionally.
